paper_title: Rethinking Repetition Problems of LLMs in Code Generation
caption: The performance of RPG applied to LLMs of different sizes. This result is the average value across three scenarios on CodeRepetEval dataset.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different configurations of LLMs across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The x-axis contains the categories, which are the four metrics labeled EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP, in that order, with arrows indicating the desired direction of performance (up for EGP and CCP, down for TR-N and TR-S). The y-axis is labeled "Performance" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. Each metric is represented by four bars corresponding to different configurations: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B), as indicated by the legend. The bars for EGP show a progression from nearly 0 for Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) to approximately 0.6 for Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), around 0.88 for RPG (CodeLlama-7B), and nearly 1.0 for RPG (CodeLlama-34B). For TR-N and TR-S, the values decrease from Greedy to RPG and from CodeLlama-7B to CodeLlama-34B, with TR-N values ranging from around 0.7 to 0.4 and TR-S values ranging from approximately 0.7 to 0.3. For CCP, the values increase from Greedy to RPG and are slightly higher for CodeLlama-34B than for CodeLlama-7B, ranging from around 0.4 to approximately 0.93. The bars are grouped by metric, with each group containing the four configurations in the same order, as indicated by the legend.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models, specifically Greedy and RPG, applied to CodeLlama models of varying sizes (7B and 34B) across four metrics: EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The horizontal axis represents the metrics, labeled as EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP, with arrows indicating the direction of improvement (↑ for higher is better, ↓ for lower is better). The vertical axis is labeled "Performance" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group consisting of four bars representing the different models: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in brown. For the EGP metric, the bars have approximate values of 0.0, 0.88, 0.6, and 0.98, respectively. For TR-N, the values are around 0.7, 0.47, 0.62, and 0.4. For TR-S, the values are approximately 0.68, 0.43, 0.46, and 0.3. For CCP, the values are around 0.4, 0.73, 0.7, and 0.93. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
